From b96a303b68dd3fe86f739fd34bd7cf194118ae89 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: SeongJae Park <sj@kernel.org>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2024 11:03:09 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] mm/damon/core: initialize ->esz_bp from
 damos_quota_init_priv()

Patch series "mm/damon: misc fixes and improvements".

Add miscelleneous and non-urgent fixes and improvements for DAMON code,
selftests, and documents.


This patch (of 10):

damos_quota_init_priv() function should initialize all private fields of
struct damos_quota.  However, it is not initializing ->esz_bp field.  This
could result in use of uninitialized variable from
damon_feed_loop_next_input() function.  There is no such issue at the
moment because every caller of the function is passing damos_quota object
that already having the field zero value.  But we cannot guarantee the
future, and the function is not doing what it is promising.  A bug is a
bug.  This fix is for preventing possible future issues.

Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20240503180318.72798-1-sj@kernel.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20240503180318.72798-2-sj@kernel.org
Fixes: 9294a037c015 ("mm/damon/core: implement goal-oriented feedback-driven quota auto-tuning")
Signed-off-by: SeongJae Park <sj@kernel.org>
Cc: Jonathan Corbet <corbet@lwn.net>
Cc: Shuah Khan <shuah@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/mm/damon/core.c b/mm/damon/core.c
index 6d503c1c125e..939ecfcd4641 100644
--- a/mm/damon/core.c
+++ b/mm/damon/core.c
@@ -346,6 +346,7 @@ static struct damos_quota *damos_quota_init(struct damos_quota *quota)
 	quota->charged_from = 0;
 	quota->charge_target_from = NULL;
 	quota->charge_addr_from = 0;
+	quota->esz_bp = 0;
 	return quota;
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `mm/damon/core.c`**
   - The function `damos_quota_init()` has been modified to include the initialization of the `esz_bp` field in the `struct damos_quota`. Specifically, the line `quota->esz_bp = 0;` has been added to ensure that this field is set to zero during the initialization process.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a potential bug in the `damos_quota_init_priv()` function, which is responsible for initializing all private fields of the `struct damos_quota`. By ensuring that the `esz_bp` field is initialized to zero, the patch prevents the risk of using an uninitialized variable in the `damon_feed_loop_next_input()` function. Although there are currently no issues because all callers are passing a `damos_quota` object with the `esz_bp` field already set to zero, this change guarantees that the function behaves correctly and consistently in the future, adhering to its intended purpose of complete initialization.

damos_quota_init_priv() function should initialize all private fields of

damon_feed_loop_next_input() function.  There is no such issue at the

Here is the root cause:
The `damos_quota_init_priv()` function fails to initialize the `esz_bp` field of the `struct damos_quota`, which could lead to the use of an uninitialized variable in the `damon_feed_loop_next_input()` function. Although current callers pass a `damos_quota` object with `esz_bp` set to zero, this behavior cannot be guaranteed in the future, making the function unreliable in its promise to initialize all fields.

Here is the patch:
 /* initialize fields of @quota that normally API users wouldn't set */
 static struct damos_quota *damos_quota_init(struct damos_quota *quota)
 {
 	quota->esz = 0;
 	quota->total_charged_sz = 0;
 	quota->total_charged_ns = 0;
 	quota->charged_sz = 0;
 	quota->charged_from = 0;
 	quota->charge_target_from = NULL;
 	quota->charge_addr_from = 0;
+	quota->esz_bp = 0;
 	return quota;
 }
